fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"Unique ID for each polygon in the feature layer, as assigned by ArcGIS Pro during processing.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: DFIRM_ID
fields.description: {"value":"Study Identifier. For a single jurisdiction Flood Risk Project, the value is composed of the two-digit State FIPS code and the four-digit FEMA CID code (e.g., 480001). For a countywide Flood Risk Project, the value is composed of the two-digit State FIPS code, the three-digit county FIPS code and the letter “C” (e.g., 48107C). Within each FIRM Database, the DFIRM_ID value will be identical.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: VERSION_ID
fields.description: {"value":"Version Identifier. Identifies the product version and relates the feature to standards according to how it was created.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: FLD_AR_ID
fields.description: {"value":"Primary key for table lookup. Assigned by FEMA S_Fld_Haz_Ar table creator. ","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: STUDY_TYP
fields.description: {"value":"Study Type. This describes the type of Flood Risk Project performed for flood hazard identification. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_Study_Typ table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: FLD_ZONE
fields.description: {"value":"Flood Zone. This is a flood zone designation. These zones are used by FEMA to designate the SFHAs. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_Zone table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: ZONE_SUBTY
fields.description: {"value":"Flood Zone Subtype. This field captures additional information about the flood zones. For example, Zone X could have “Area With Reduced Flood Risk Due To Levee” or “0.2 Percent Annual Chance Flood Hazard” as a subtype. Types of floodways are also stored in this field. Floodways are designated by FEMA and adopted by communities to provide an area that will remain free of development to moderate increases in flood heights due to encroachment on the floodplain. ","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: SFHA_TF
fields.alias: Special Flood Hazard Area, True or False
fields.description: {"value":"Special Flood Hazard Area. If the area is within a SFHA this field would be true. This field will be true for any area coded as an A or V flood zone area. It should be false for any X or D flood areas. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_TrueFalse table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: STATIC_BFE
fields.description: {"value":"Static Base Flood Elevation. This field will be populated for areas that have been determined to have a constant Base Flood Elevation (BFE) over a flood zone. The BFE value will be shown beneath the zone label. In this situation the same BFE applies to the entire polygon. This normally occurs in lakes or coastal zones.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: V_DATUM
fields.description: {"value":"Vertical Datum. The vertical datum indicates the reference surface from which the flood elevations are measured. Normally this would be North American Vertical Datum of 1988 for new studies. This field is only populated if the STATIC_BFE field is populated. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_V_Datum table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: DEPTH
fields.description: {"value":"This is the depth for Zone AO areas. This value is shown beneath the zone label on the FIRM. This field is only populated if a depth is shown on the FIRM.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: LEN_UNIT
fields.description: {"value":"Length Units. This unit indicates the measurement system used for the BFEs and/or depths. Normally this would be feet. This field is only populated if the STATIC_BFE or DEPTH field is populated. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_Length_Units table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: VELOCITY
fields.description: {"value":"Velocity. This is the velocity measurement of the flood flow in the area. Normally this is applicable to alluvial fan areas (certain Zone AO areas). This value is shown beneath the zone label on the FIRM. This field is only populated when a velocity is associated with the flood zone area.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: VEL_UNIT
fields.description: {"value":"Velocity Unit. This is the unit of measurement for the velocity. This field is populated when the VELOCITY field is populated. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_Velocity_Units table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: DUAL_ZONE
fields.description: {"value":"Flood Control Restoration Zones – Dual Zone Classification. If the flood hazard areas shown on the effective FIRM shall be designated as “dual” SFHAs (i.e., Zone AR/AE, Zone AR/AH, Zone AR/AO, Zone AR/A), this field will be coded as true. It should be false for any for AR Zones that revert to Shaded X. Acceptable values for this field are listed in the D_TrueFalse table.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: SOURCE_CIT
fields.description: {"value":"Source Citation. Abbreviation used in the metadata file when describing the source information for the feature. The abbreviation must match a value in L_Source_Cit.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: GFID
fields.description: {"value":"GFID","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: esri_symbology
fields.description: {"value":"Symbology used by ESRI Living Atlas to cartographically render polygons in the online layer, and in the legend. This symbology classification is interpreted from the combination of the Flood Zone and Flood Zone Subtype fields, as defined during conversations with FEMA about practical cartography for the National Flood Hazard Layer.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: GlobalID
fields.description: {"value":"Global ID assigned by ESRI Living Atlas during feature layer production.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: Shape__Area
fields.description: {"value":"Area of a polygon in square meters, as calculated in web mercator projection. Using an equal area projection to calculate area is recommended.","fieldValueType":""}

fields.name: Shape__Length
fields.description: {"value":"Length of a polygon perimeter in meters, as calculated in web mercator projection. Using an equal area projection to calculate length is recommended.","fieldValueType":""}
